title: Crash in GDExtension documentation generation when using `--headless --import` or `--headless --editor --quit`
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.5.beta4 (oldest version where the precompiled GDExtension in the MRP runs), 4.5.stable

### System information

Godot v4.6.dev (8d8041bd4) - Fedora Linux 42 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (nvidia; 580.82.09) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 62.33 GiB memory

### Issue description

The editor crashes in GDExtension documentation generation when using `--headless --editor --quit`. This does not occur with GDScript documentation generation from my testing.

Using `--quit-after`, you need a value of at least `35` in the MRP for it to work. In [godot-benchmarks](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-benchmarks), you need a value of at least `12` instead, so it's project-dependent.

Note that if you use `--frame-delay` (which impacts headless usage unlike `--max-fps`), you can use a lower value as it'll wait more time between iterations. With `--frame-delay 100` or more, `--quit-after 3` is sufficient to make it work without crashing. With `--frame-delay 800` or more, `--import` will also work.

Backtrace:

```
ERROR: FATAL: Index p_index = 1 is out of bounds (size() = 0).
   at: get (./core/templates/cowdata.h:187)
```

**The issue is timing-sensitive**, so if you attach gdb to the process, you may not be able to reproduce it anymore. This hints at some kind of race condition. In fact, **if you compile with `threads=no`** ([`sdl=no` is also needed on Linux right now](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/111049)), it will work even with `--import` and no frame delay.

In godot-benchmarks, [the issue doesn't occur when using `--import` instead of `--editor`, which is generally more robust](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-benchmarks/commit/b26eb4c5a15e8c35b5579cabb65333721d7455f4). However, in this MRP, it also occurs when using `--import`.

### Steps to reproduce

- Build the GDExtension included in the MRP:
  - `cd addons/test_extension`
  - `wget https://github.com/godotengine/godot-cpp/archive/refs/heads/master.zip`
  - `unzip master.zip && rm master.zip`
  - `mv godot-cpp-master src/godot-cpp`
  - `scons`
- **Building is required, otherwise you can't reproduce the issue.** The MRP includes the MRP precompiled for Linux x86_64, but not for Windows or macOS.
- Ensure there is no `.godot/` folder in the project, so that documentation generation occurs when using `--headless --editor`.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test_gdextension.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22606467/test_gdextension.zip)
